form.label: Overview
form.description: What the Absolute data shows: SIEM event types, console activity, alerts, security posture changes, and the device inventory from the latest snapshot.

search.query: index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:events" | stats count dc(dest) as devices latest(_time) as last_seen by eventType verb | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | sort - count
index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:events" | timechart limit=8 useother=true count by eventType

panel.title: Console activity (sign-ins, account and settings changes, device actions, location lookups)

search.query: index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:events" actorObjectType="User" | eval target=coalesce(nullif(objectDisplayName, ""), objectObjectType), detail=coalesce(nullif(secondaryObjectDisplayName, ""), "") | table _time actorDisplayName eventType verb target detail src | rename actorDisplayName as console_user | sort - _time
index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:events" eventType IN ("AlertTriggered", "DeviceConnectionBlocked", "DeviceConnectionUnblocked") | table _time eventType signature dest description | sort - _time

index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:events" eventType IN ("DeviceBecameUnencrypted", "DeviceBecameEncrypted", "DeviceBecameAVUnprotected", "DeviceBecameAVProtected", "DeviceAVProductChanged", "APDeviceBecameNonCompliant", "APDeviceBecameCompliant", "APDeviceBecameError", "DeviceExitedItsGeofence") | stats count dc(dest) as devices by eventType | sort - count

panel.title: Devices in the latest snapshot, by operating system

search.query: index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:devices" | dedup deviceUid | stats count by os | sort - count

index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:devices" | dedup deviceUid | eval encryption_status=spath(_raw, "espInfo.encryptionStatus"), antivirus=spath(_raw, "avpInfo.antivirusName") | fillnull value="(none)" encryption_status antivirus | stats count by status encryption_status antivirus | sort - count
